pages.text: Blueberries come from the Blueberry Crop. Harvest the crop once it is fully grown to get blueberries.$(br2)They're small, but they have a few uses beyond just eating them.

pages.title: Blueberry
pages.text: Blueberries can be eaten and used in other foods.$(br2)See $(l:whatsits:foods_drinks)Food & Drinks$(/l) for some of their other uses.
